## Sharp RDD with Simulated Data

Simulates a discontinuity at zero and compares default and customized local-linear RDD estimates.

```{webr}
library(rdd)

## DGP
x<-runif(1000,-1,1)
y<-3+2*x+10*(x>=0)+rnorm(1000)

## Estimation; the default bandwidth is IK and kernel is triangular. You can specify them by "bw=" and "kernel="
## If you want to add covariates (cov), then write RDestimate(y~x|cov). 
model1=RDestimate(y~x) 
model2=RDestimate(y~x,bw=c(0.1,0.2,0.3),kernel="gaussian")
summary(model1)
summary(model2)
plot(model1)
```

## House Elections RDD

Loads house.csv and estimates the electoral discontinuity with local-linear regression.

```{webr}
library(rdd)
data=read.csv("house.csv")
y=data$y
x=data$x
model=RDestimate(y~x)
summary(model)
```
